keep_inline_images_in naming 'a' keeps an image inside a link that also holds a block element

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ConversionOptions, convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const options: ConversionOptions = { keepInlineImagesIn: ["a"] };
  const result = convert("<a href=\"https://example.com/file.pdf\"><img src=\"pdf.png\"><p>Download PDF</p></a>", options);
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
